title: 第21章 出售丹药第22章 检测灵根
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
“薛掌柜，这是37瓶回气丹，请查验一下。”丹霞阁内，秦怀安把近期炼制的回气丹都交给了薛掌柜。
薛掌柜打开几瓶回气丹看看了，都是新近炼制的，内心暗暗吃惊。50份灵草竟然炼制成功了37瓶，成功率超过七成了。
薛掌柜自己炼制这么多年丹药，回气丹的成功率也刚刚超过七成。他自己可是已经炼制了几十年丹药了，秦小友炼丹天赋竟然如此恐怖。
“秦小友，没什么问题，按我们约定的80灵石一瓶价格收购，扣除材料费用，还需支付你2210下品灵石。”
“薛掌柜，再扣除这次的50份灵草费用吧。”秦怀安不准备继续预支灵草了，毕竟现在灵石足够。
“好，这是1460块下品灵石。”薛掌柜把灵石递给秦怀安，然后招呼伙计道，“王贵，去准备50份炼制回气丹的灵草。”
“是，掌柜的。”王贵现在看秦怀安的目光都是有些敬畏的。想不到短短时间，秦怀安不仅修为提升到他仰望的地步，炼丹成功率竟也如此之高。
“多谢薛掌柜！”秦怀安取过灵石和灵草，回到自己的洞府继续炼丹、继续修炼。
他现在吸收灵气的速度已经要比炼气五层有提高了很多，修为越高吸收灵气的速度越快。现在就算不用灵石修炼，吸收灵气的速度也和炼气五层使用灵石修炼的速度差不多了。
如果现在用下品灵石修炼，镜像体和本体一起修炼，每天要消耗200块以上的灵石。
秦怀安近期不打算用灵石修炼了，他要积攒一些灵石，用于以后提升功法。
宗门集中招收正式开始的前一天，秦怀安又一次来丹霞阁交丹药，这已经是他第三次交丹药了。
“薛掌柜，这次我先不购买灵草了。”
薛掌柜把这次的灵石给了秦怀安之后说道：“秦小友，明天宗门招收就正式开始了，小友可有意向的门派？”
秦怀安最近也对这次的宗门招收有了一些了解。来云天坊市招收的宗门主要是黄山剑宗和隶属于黄山剑宗势力范围的一些宗门。
黄山剑宗在这个区域是绝对的霸主级存在，实力远超其他宗门。
黄山剑宗之下有四家二流宗门，这四家宗门相对于黄山剑宗自然是差距甚远，但这四家宗门实力又明显强于其他十多家小宗门。
其中丹霞宗就是这四家二流宗门之一。
“暂时还没有意向宗门，明天先测试一下做自己的灵根资质吧。”秦怀安自然是想加入黄山剑宗的，但黄山剑宗对资质的要求很高。
“秦小友现在刚刚23岁吧，23岁就已经炼气六层了，相信灵根资质也不会太差。”薛掌柜微笑道。

“我丹霞宗专精于炼丹，秦小友如果想往炼丹方向发展，丹霞宗是个不错的选择。”
“当然，以朋友的身份来说，如果秦小友能进黄山剑宗，那黄山剑宗自然是最好的。”薛掌柜对秦怀安说道。
“多谢薛掌柜提醒！一切等灵根资质测试后再说。”秦怀安抱拳谢过薛掌柜之后，就出了丹霞阁。
今天的云田坊极为热闹，街上熙熙攘攘的修士都在谈论着明天的宗门招收。
秦怀安没有在内城久留，直接回到了自己的租住的洞府。
刚到门口，正好看到小胖子王宝乐在敲他的门。
“胖子！”
content_en:
"Shopkeeper Xue, these are 37 bottles of Qi-Returning Pills, please check them." In Danxia Pavilion, Qin Huaian handed over all the recently refined Qi-Returning Pills to Shopkeeper Xue.
Shopkeeper Xue opened several bottles of Qi Restoration Pills and looked at them. They were all recently refined, and he was secretly surprised. 37 bottles of 50 pieces of spiritual grass were successfully refined, with a success rate of over 70%.
Shopkeeper Xue has been refining the pill himself for so many years, and the success rate of the Qi Restoration Pill is just over 70%. He himself has been refining elixirs for decades, but Qin Xiaoyou's talent in elixir refining is so terrifying.
"Little friend Qin, there is no problem. I will buy it at the agreed price of 80 spirit stones per bottle. After deducting the material cost, I still need to pay you 2210 low-grade spirit stones."
"Shopkeeper Xue, let's deduct 50 more spiritual herbs this time." Qin Huaian is not going to continue to advance the spiritual herbs. After all, there are enough spiritual stones now.
"Okay, here are 1,460 pieces of low-grade spirit stones." Shopkeeper Xue handed the spirit stones to Qin Huaian, and then called to the waiter, "Wang Gui, go and prepare 50 pieces of spiritual grass for refining the Qi Restoration Pill."
"Yes, from the shopkeeper." Wang Gui now looked at Qin Huaian with awe. Unexpectedly, in such a short period of time, Qin Huaian not only improved his cultivation to a level that he looked up to, but his success rate in alchemy was also so high.
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Xue!" Qin Huaian took the spiritual stones and spiritual herbs and returned to his cave to continue refining elixirs and practicing.
His current speed of absorbing spiritual energy is much higher than that of the fifth level of Qi Refining. The higher his cultivation level, the faster he absorbs spiritual energy. Now even if you don't use spiritual stones to practice, the speed of absorbing spiritual energy is almost the same as the speed of using spiritual stones to practice at the fifth level of Qi refining.
If you use low-grade spiritual stones to practice now, and practice the mirror body and the main body together, you will consume more than 200 spiritual stones every day.
Qin Huaian doesn't plan to use spiritual stones to practice in the near future. He wants to accumulate some spiritual stones to improve his skills in the future.
The day before the sect's centralized recruitment officially started, Qin Huaian came to Danxia Pavilion to hand over pills again. This was the third time he handed over pills.
"Shopkeeper Xue, I won't buy any spiritual herbs this time."
After giving this spiritual stone to Qin Huaian, Shopkeeper Xue said, "Little friend Qin, the sect recruitment will officially begin tomorrow. Is there any sect you are interested in?"
Qin Huaian also recently learned something about the sect's recruitment. The sects that come to Yuntianfang City to recruit are mainly the Huangshan Sword Sect and some sects affiliated with the Huangshan Sword Sect's sphere of influence.
Huangshan Sword Sect is the absolute overlord in this area, and its strength far exceeds that of other sects.
There are four second-rate sects under the Huangshan Sword Sect. These four sects are naturally far behind the Huangshan Sword Sect, but the strength of these four sects is obviously stronger than more than a dozen other small sects.
Among them, Danxia Sect is one of these four second-rate sects.
"I don't have any intention to apply to the sect yet. Let's test my spiritual root qualifications tomorrow." Qin Huaian naturally wanted to join the Huangshan Sword Sect, but the Huangshan Sword Sect had very high requirements for qualifications.
"Qin Xiaoyou is just 23 years old now. He has already reached the sixth level of Qi Refining at the age of 23. I believe his spiritual root qualifications are not too bad." Shopkeeper Xue said with a smile.
"My Danxia Sect specializes in alchemy. If Qin Xiaoyou wants to develop in the direction of alchemy, Danxia Sect is a good choice."
"Of course, as a friend, if Qin Xiaoyou can enter the Huangshan Sword Sect, then the Huangshan Sword Sect will naturally be the best." Shopkeeper Xue said to Qin Huaian.
"Thank you, Shopkeeper Xue, for reminding me! We will wait until the spiritual root qualification test is completed." Qin Huaian cupped his fists and thanked Shopkeeper Xue before leaving Danxia Pavilion.
Today's Yuntianfang is extremely lively, and the bustling monks on the street are talking about tomorrow's sect recruitment.
Qin Huaian did not stay in the inner city for long and returned directly to his rented cave.
When he arrived at the door, he happened to see the fat boy Wang Baole knocking on his door.
"Fat man!"
